The one trend that is alive: SP carries a 3W streak across all four ratings (R1-R4), while bullpen_fatigue is mired in a 5L skid across the board. That split matters for tonight's board — lean into games where SP grading aligns with the pick, and treat any play that hinges purely on bullpen_fatigue with real skepticism given the extended cold run at 47% season-wide (520-598) and five straight losses. If a starting-pitcher-driven side and a bullpen_fatigue-driven side point in opposite directions on the same game, side with SP.

On category combos, trends+sp remains the top agreement play at 58.0% (370-268, n=638), followed by trends+runs at 57.3% and trends+bullpen at 56.8% — look for tonight's games where multiple ratings converge on trends and sp together, since that's the strongest statistical overlap in the data and historically the most reliable signal when it fires. Team-wise, if LAD or BOS show up as a liked side tonight, lean in hard — LAD is 80% on strong plays (28-7, +27.0u) and BOS sits at 76% (22-7, +19.0u), both dramatically outperforming a name like NYY, where strong plays are underwater at 39% (9-14, -4.0u). Any NYY strong-play pick tonight should be treated as a fade candidate unless multiple categories stack hard in its favor.
